summary: No actionable finding in the accepted RS-22 restructuring. Checked every member target, all eight directed overlap leads, all thirteen links and the existing local decomposition. Keeping the two geometric settings is justified; all stage descriptions and existing edges survive, the retitle applies, and no RS-22 edge closes a cycle in the checked unions.

Tested the four unordered overlap pairs represented by eight leads: global-curve Hecke versus Fargues-Fontaine Hecke, global Frobenius shtukas versus Hecke correspondences, global versus framed local shtuka moduli, and global Galois versus local Weil Drinfeld descent. Neither trace-to-spherical-function comparison nor a finite-wild local parameter theorem supplies classical global Satake or general global parameter reconstruction.

Read all thirteen reviewed coverage entries. Verified that HS's retained solid/continuous/pro-p interfaces and downstream uniform-wild owner are compatible with these source scopes; this is not a complete proof audit of the whole roadmap.

Ran check_restructure.check against the pinned target/family/atlas: no errors. Actual application after other accepted proposals adds nine links, skips none; the other four proposed handoffs already exist. The HS roadmap title updates as requested.

Ran return-path checks for each proposed edge in native stageEdges plus in-registry requires plus RS-22 (3517 edges), then all twenty-five accepted link maps (4124), then all twenty-seven applied restructuring proposals (7007): no return path in any union.

Compared applied neighboring ownership/layer records: none reassigns an RS-22 member target. Retained the known late HS3 realization-return granularity issue without inventing a reverse coarse edge or claiming the comparison proved.

stageChecks.assessment: Global-curve Bun_G, levels, deformations/HN bounded opens, automorphisms, central degree, torsor-class adelic comparison and nonsplit descent remain. Fargues-Fontaine BG2 is not a replacement.

Classical Beilinson-Drinfeld geometry, bounded Hecke stacks, fusion, rational ell-adic Satake, pinning/commutativity/half twists and nonsplit descent remain. The Fargues-Fontaine Satake and trace-comparison stages do not construct this equivalence.

Global Frobenius-modification direction, bounds, levels, partial Frobenius, HN truncations, central lattices, stabilizer-qualified representability and local-model maps remain. DM.7 is only an optional specialized realization.

Stack-specific bounded compact-support IC, transition maps/colimit, Hecke correspondences and Hecke-finite/cuspidal comparison remain. EDC.5 supplies scheme IC, not this whole stack construction; FA.6 supplies the automorphic object.
Classical partial-Frobenius descent, its Hecke-finite application, global Galois product action, independence and coalescence remain. VS1's local divisor/Weil theorem is not substituted.

Global excursions, relations, continuous semisimple reconstruction, cuspidal generalized-eigenspace decomposition, nonsplit projection and unramified comparison remain. Local parameter algebra does not by itself supply global Galois reconstruction or surjectivity.

Independent Laurent Lafforgue GL_n compactification, boundary/negligible cohomology, induction, trace route and both directions remain, with finite-order determinant/central character and separate twists.

Global restriction versus local parameter, uniformization and nearby-cycle comparison maps remain extra proof obligations. HS2/HS3 supply local endpoints; ES7 supplies only the specialized equal-characteristic realization, not general ramified-G compatibility or monodromy recovery.

Two Fargues-Fontaine bundles with meromorphic off-divisor isomorphism, source/target/leg maps, bounds, descent, chains/collisions and group compatibilities remain. Relative-fibre properties are not promoted to global-map representability.

Actual Satake kernels and solid relative-homology construction, preservation/scalar-extension/unit/composition and continuous local Weil action remain. VS1, completed Satake and solid/lisse suppliers stay prerequisites; no early global-Langlands dependency added.

Framed b,b-prime fibres, two local-group actions, levels/transition maps, bounded representability/local spatiality, reflex descent and justified inverse limits remain. General bounds are not reduced to minuscule classical examples; comparison proofs remain.

Ordered coefficient and level limits, compact-support complexes, commuting actions, fibre/base-change comparison, source-range compactness/admissibility, duality and level-change maps remain. No finite-dimensional infinite-level claim or index-division without invertibility.

Permutation, dual-leg creation/annihilation, triangles, iterated modification and finite-set coherence remain. HS4 supplies geometric group diagrams; parameter identities and uniform wild cutoff stay downstream in ES6/7 and ES1 respectively.
